snippet.title: Red Hat Summit
snippet.description:
LEARN. NETWORK. EXPERIENCE OPEN SOURCE.

Red Hat Summit 2019 was our largest gathering of customers, partners, and open source contributors yet—a gathering of the curious learning how to expand their possibilities.

Whether you were there to share the experience and want to review a session, see one you missed, or share one with a colleague—or you weren't able to make it this year at all—participate in our Red Hat Summit virtual event to watch some of the most sought-after Summit sessions.

https://red.ht/summit2019virtualevent
